Who we are

About VP Auto Mobile Mechanic

VP Auto is a family-owned mobile mechanic servicing Penrith, Emu Plains and Western Sydney. Log book servicing, repairs, brakes, clutches, suspension and pre-purchase inspections — done at your home, your work, or wherever the car decides to stop. No towing, no waiting rooms.

  • We come to you
  • Open 7 days
  • Family owned
